## Summary

Describe the change and the reason for it.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor or maintenance
- [ ] Model or evaluation change

## Validation

- [ ] I ran the relevant tests.
- [ ] I checked the application starts where applicable.
- [ ] I updated documentation where needed.
- [ ] I did not add secrets, credentials, private data, or unapproved model weights.
- [ ] I did not make unsupported accuracy or performance claims.

## Model/data changes (if applicable)

Describe changes to preprocessing, class order, training data, checkpoints, thresholds, or evaluation methodology. Include reproducible evidence and dataset provenance where possible.

## Screenshots or logs

Add screenshots or relevant test output when useful.
